name: Risk-Managed Momentum
description: Momentum selection (top-3 cross-sectional 12-month) wrapped in VolatilityTargetStrategy overlay. Scales gross exposure by target_vol / realized_vol (6-month window), capped at 1.0 (no leverage, long-only). Targets 15% annualized volatility. Based on Barroso & Santa-Clara (2015) vol-premium logic: momentum crashes are forecastable from momentum vol spikes; risk-managed scaling harvests momentum premium while sidestepping crash risk. Expected Sharpe uplift and shallower max drawdown versus constant-weight momentum.
